newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese yuan stable in lighter trade in November.
newsitem.headline: Chinese yuan stable in lighter trade in November.

text.p: The Chinese yuan was little changed against the U.S. dollar in lighter trading in November on the Shanghai-based China Foreign Exchange Trade System, the Shanghai Securities News said on Wednesday.
The yuan ended the month at 8.3012 against the dollar, down 15 points from 8.2997 at the end of October, it said.
Daily volume was $263 million yuan, a daily drop of $4.0 million each day, it said.
In the market, a national interbank foreign exchange trading market, the yuan trades against the U.S. dollar, Hong Kong dollar and Japanese yen.
The newspaper did not give reasons for the changes.
Chinese bankers said the yuan was stable in November mainly due to a dollar surplus on the market balanced by a high yuan rate against the dollar after rises in the previous few months.
